persons.name: Bṛhaspati
persons.evidence: lekhaka śrībṛhaspatiḥ ... lekhaka kvātha bhānta hemavarṇṇa mahāvyahāra ... vidyārthi śrībṛhaspateḥ svārthe likhitāḥ

notes: Fol. 169v has an internal colophon dated 'saṃvat 951 mti bhādra vadi 13', whereas the final colophon on fol. 298v gives 'saṃvat 941 mti pauṣa vadi 2'; Hemavarṇa Mahāvihāra is Kvābāhā / Hiraṇyavarṇa Mahāvihāra in Patan.
